jobs.occupation: Oliver Wyman – Senior Consultant- (m/f/d) – Stockholm or Copenhagen
jobs.description:
**Who We Are

**Oliver Wyman is a global management consulting firm. We work with clients through their most defining moments, combining deep industry knowledge, specialized expertise, and the power of perspective to help them adapt, grow, and thrive.

We believe diverse perspectives make the work stronger. Our consultants bring different backgrounds, experiences, and ways of thinking to help solve complex problems and create lasting impact for clients, colleagues, and communities.

At Oliver Wyman, we are proud of the values that we aspire to live by. We are committed to creating an inclusive environment where everyone can thrive and reach their full potential.

**What You Will Do

**As a Senior Consultant, you will play a pivotal role in shaping client engagements from problem definition through implementation. You will work alongside colleagues of all levels and clients to solve complex problems and drive meaningful change.

You’ll help teams understand client strategic challenges while helping develop the next generation of consultants.

**You will:

**

• Lead workstreams on client engagements, structuring analyses and developing actionable recommendations that support client decision-making.

• Frame hypotheses, identify key business questions, and direct quantitative and qualitative research to generate insights.

• Apply structured problem-solving and analytical thinking to solve complex business issues.

• Develop high-quality client deliverables, including presentations, analysis, workshops, models, and discussions that help move projects forward.

• You’ll have the opportunity to work across our industries and capabilities, with the flexibility to specialize early or explore different areas before choosing a path.

• You’ll likely have the chance to travel within your home market and internationally. No two weeks are ever the same.

• Manage and coach junior team members, fostering an inclusive, collaborative, and high-performing team environment.

• Build trusted relationships with clients through clear communication and effective stakeholder management.

**Why join us?

****You can be your best here

**At Oliver Wyman, you will find meaningful work, talented people, and a culture built on trust, support, and growth.

**Create solutions that have impact

**

• Work on challenging projects that help clients solve complex problems, make better decisions, and create meaningful impact.

• Have the opportunity to work across different industries, capabilities, and cultures, contributing to work that has lasting impact for clients, industries, and society.

• Be part of teams that measure success not just by deliverables, but by the difference created together.

**Develop as a leader

**

• Lead workstreams and develop expertise that colleagues and clients seek out.

• Mentor junior consultants while continuing to build your own leadership capabilities.

• Take ownership of client relationships and increasingly complex engagements.

**Learn and grow without limits

**

• Continue developing specialized expertise through challenging projects and formal learning opportunities.

• Collaborate with industry specialists and global experts across Oliver Wyman.

• Build a sustainable career supported by coaching, mentoring, and continuous professional development.

• You’ll have support around you as you grow, including a dedicated buddy, a career advisor, your talent manager, and communities that help you find your place.

**Thrive in a vibrant and inclusive culture

**

• Work with genuine colleagues who stand by their beliefs, collaborate across differences, and support one another.

• Be part of an open, inclusive, and down-to-earth culture where diverse perspectives strengthen the work.

• Connect with colleagues through employee resource groups, office communities, and social activities.

**Experience Rewards That Work For You

**

• We believe in flexibility, including hybrid working, and in helping colleagues build sustainable careers.

• Over time, you’ll have access to opportunities, programs, and experiences designed to help you perform, grow, and thrive — including non-profit fellowships, sabbaticals, and externships.

• Enjoy competitive local benefits designed to support your well-being, development, and life outside of work.

**Who can apply?

**We are looking for top-performing professionals who are passionate about solving complex business problems, enjoy developing high-impact content, and are excited to build a long-term career at a leading strategy consulting firm characterized by sustained double-digit growth, an entrepreneurial spirit, and a strong focus on culture and career sustainability.

**Required Qualifications

**

• 3+ years of relevant experience in a top-tier strategy consulting firm.

• Experience serving clients within Banking and Financial Services, Finance and Risk, Restucturing, Insurance, Logistic, is highly advantageous.

• Undergraduate or advanced degree in STEM, Finance, Economics, or a related quantitative discipline from a leading university.

• Outstanding analytical and quantitative problem-solving capabilities with the ability to structure ambiguous business problems.

• Excellent written and verbal communication skills with the ability to communicate effectively across different audiences and seniority levels.

• Demonstrated experience working collaboratively in cross-functional, fast-paced environments.

• Proven ability to deliver results under pressure while managing multiple priorities.

• Fluent business English and another Scandinavian language

• Willingness to travel internationally as client needs require.

**Nice to have

**

• Data analytics, advanced quantitative modelling, or data science capabilities.

• CFA or equivalent professional certification.

• MBA or Master's degree from a top-tier university.

**What we're looking for?

**Successful candidates demonstrate:

• Intellectual curiosity and structured problem solving.

• Strong ownership and accountability.

• Excellent interpersonal and relationship-building skills.

• An inclusive leadership style and commitment to developing others.

• Adaptability, resilience, and entrepreneurial thinking.

• A collaborative mindset with the ability to work respectfully across diverse teams and cultures.

**How to apply?

**Please submit your CV, cover letter, and academic transcripts. If you would like to find out more information about Oliver Wyman, please visit our website.

**What to expect during the interviews process?

**At Oliver Wyman, we want you to shine in your interview. Our process is designed like our work environment — it’s challenging, exciting, and fun.

With a mix of conversational and case interviews, our approach not only helps us to get to know you better, understanding your strengths and interests, but it also enables you to learn more about our people and our business..

Oliver Wyman is a business of Marsh (NYSE: MRSH), a global leader in risk, reinsurance and capital, people and investments, and management consulting, advising clients in 130 countries. With annual revenue of over $27 billion and more than 95,000 colleagues, Marsh helps build the confidence to thrive through the power of perspective. For more information, visit oliverwyman.com, or follow us on LinkedIn and X.

Marsh is committed to creating a diverse, inclusive and flexible work environment. We aim to attract and retain the best people and embrace diversity of age, background, disability, ethnic origin, family duties, gender orientation or expression, marital status, nationality, parental status, personal or social status, political affiliation, race, religion and beliefs, sex/gender, sexual orientation or expression, skin color, or any other characteristic protected by applicable law.

Marsh is committed to hybrid work, which includes the flexibility of working remotely and the collaboration, connections and professional development benefits of working together in the office. All Marsh colleagues are expected to be in their local office or working onsite with clients at least three days per week. Office-based teams will identify at least one “anchor day” per week on which their full team will be together in person.

Steel Fitters

Key tasks:

Your job as steel fitter will be responsible for assembling, positioning, aligning, and fitting structural steel components to create frameworks for buildings, bridges, ships, and heavy machinery.

🔹 Rengøring af kontorer og fællesområder

🔹 Håndværkerrengøring og oprydning

🔹 Affaldshåndtering

✅ En varieret arbejdsdag – både inde og ude

✅ Ordentlige arbejdsforhold

✅ Et sundt og uformelt arbejdsmiljø

✅ Gode kolleger, der hjælper hinanden

✅ Mulighed for faglig udvikling

✅ En arbejdsplads med klare værdier

HØJ EKSPERTISE · LAV BØVLFAKTOR · FÆLLES MÅL

Vi søger dig, som:

✔️ Er mødestabil og ansvarsbevidst

KEY ACCOUNT MANAGER

Vald. BIRN A/S in Holstebro is looking for a technically qualified and commercially focused Key Account Manager for its sales of high quality cast iron solutions.

THE POSITION

In order to consolidate and expand our sales activities, we need to strengthen our sales team by recruiting a qualified Key Account Manager.

You will be given responsibility for strategically important customers, all of which are market-leading OEMs or system providers, including those in the truck sector. Your role will be to expand and enhance the sales turnover among existing customers, while at the same time cultivating new customer relationships. A significant part of the role also involves making sustained efforts to secure up-to-date framework agreements and contracts in addition to communicating customer requirements and expectations.

The sales process consists of offering to produce the customers’ cast iron components. Once the items are being produced, the sales work will involve continuously negotiating and adjusting the sales prices of the individual components, as well as negotiating and maintaining other commercial conditions. These conditions include packaging, logistics solutions, framework agreements for quality and delivery, and aftermarket terms.

Your normal working day will vary from administrative tasks at the office in Holstebro, where you will work closely with Production, the Production Engineering Department (PED), Business Controlling and other company stakeholders. You will also be responsible for planning and conducting your external customer visits, primarily in Europe where you can expect up to around 50 days’ travelling per year. You will also help with and prepare data and presentations for sales meetings and trade fair attendance, as well as continuously reporting to Sales Management.

As part of a cross-organisational partnership, you will familiarise yourself with the customers’ projects and thus become the most important link of the contact between the customer and your colleagues across the entire organisation.

When out visiting customers with a view to sales, you will always have a ‘One Stop Shop’ cast iron solution to call upon. By this, we mean that BIRN is able to cast, machine, assemble and surface-treat the products so that they can be delivered directly to the customer’s production line or application without further processing. This is both efficient and sustainable.

Are you looking to combine your technical curiosity and skills with a strategic responsibility for sales and long-term customer relationships in an international industrial group? If so, you may be the person we are looking for as a Key Account Manager.

YOUR DUTIES

You will be given a central role in the sales organisation, with your work including the following:

·       Responsibility for and the continued development of a portfolio of four to six major strategic customers in Europe, primarily in Scandinavia. You will be responsible for a turnover of at least € 25 million

·       Building up long-term relationships with the customers’ stakeholders in the fields of purchasing, development, quality and logistics

·       Technical and commercial advice during the customers’ development and project phases

·       Planning and conducting customer visits, contract and price negotiations and major framework agreements

·       Ongoing budget monitoring, forecasts and sales reports at customer level

·       Searching for, analysing and developing new customer potentials and market segments

·       Close internal collaboration with production engineering, quality, controlling and finance

·       Participation in sales and strategy activities across the organisation

The position involves some travel, primarily in Europe.

QUALIFICATIONS

We expect you to have the following:

·       Extensive advanced technical training/experience, ideally supplemented with commercial skills, e.g. engineer, marine engineer or equivalent. A skilled trade background, supplemented by commercial training or experience, is another option

·       Experience of technical sales, project sales or Key Account Management; alternatively, you will have been recently trained and have the right level of drive. The start date will be adapted to suit the right candidate

·       The ability to thrive in an outward-facing role with extensive customer contact, and to plan your day-to-day work independently

·       The ability to work in a structured manner on CRM, budgets, documentation and monitoring. You will need to be skilled in using digital tools, for processing both text and numbers

·       The ability to communicate without difficulty in English and, preferably, also in Danish – and, ideally, in the other Scandinavian languages

·       The technical flair and ability to get to grips with the customers’ business and applications

·       A passenger car driving licence and a valid passport with no travel restrictions

At a personal level, you will be skilled in relationships, persistent and curious, with the motivation to create value through collaboration based on trust and a high level of professionalism.

WHAT WE OFFER

You will become part of Vald. BIRN A/S, a solid and internationally represented industrial enterprise with strong values and a high degree of professionalism. In addition, you will receive:

·       A central, independent role with a high level of influence on customers, sales and commercial development

·       A strong professional environment with close collaboration across the Group

·       Thorough on-boarding and training in products, markets and the organisation

·       Good opportunities for both professional and personal development

·       Attractive terms and conditions of employment, including a pension scheme and health insurance

·       A good canteen scheme and active staff association

·       An informal work environment that focuses on well-being, responsibility and sustainability

ABOUT THE BIRN GROUP

Vald. BIRN A/S in Holstebro is the Group Headquarters of one of Northern Europe’s largest foundry Groups. We supply highly processed cast iron components to the truck industry and others, as well as industrial hydraulics and machine components. Sustainability, the circular economy and responsibility are integral parts of our DNA. The Group employs around 750 staff, of which around 480 are in Holstebro.

APPLICATIONS

If you have any questions about the position or the BIRN Group, please feel free to contact Group CSO Peter Frost Jepsen on tel. +45 3016 0160 or Group HR Manager Morten Madsen on tel. +45 3016 0115.

Please note that we are processing applications on a continuous basis and will close the position once we have found the right candidate. As mentioned above, the start date can be adjusted to suit the right candidate. Please submit your application via our recruitment system, which you will find at [insert link]. Candidates who proceed to a second interview can expect to complete a personality profile as part of the process.

We would encourage all qualified candidates, regardless of gender, ethnicity or age, to apply for the position.

jobs.occupation: Kitchen Manager Røghus - Full-Time · Flyverbyen, Amager
jobs.description:
RØGHUS is looking for an organized and reliable Kitchen Manager to join our growing team in Flyverbyen, Amager.

ABOUT RØGHUS

RØGHUS is a Danish catering and food truck company with a love for food made with smoke and fire.

We are best known for traditional American BBQ and authentic Mexican-inspired food, but most importantly, we believe in making great food from scratch, using quality ingredients and taking pride in the craft behind everything we serve.

For us, RØGHUS is about more than food. It is about hospitality, creating great experiences and treating customers, colleagues and partners with respect. We are an ambitious company, but we also want RØGHUS to be a place where people enjoy coming to work and feel responsible for what we create together.

Currently, our business consists of catering and our food truck, and we are looking for the right person to take responsibility for the day-to-day organization of our kitchen.

ABOUT THE POSITION

As our Kitchen Manager, you will be responsible for keeping the kitchen organized and running smoothly.

• 
Overall organization of the kitchen

• 
Cleaning routines and making sure our hygiene standards are maintained

• 
Staff scheduling

• 
General kitchen maintenance and keeping equipment and work areas in good condition

• 
Purchasing and ordering ingredients, supplies and other necessary goods

• 
Keeping track of stock and helping ensure that we have what we need for upcoming catering jobs and food truck events

• 
Helping create structure and good routines in a growing company

• 
Working closely with the rest of the RØGHUS team

Previous experience from a professional kitchen or a similar position is appreciated, but it is not a requirement.

For us, it is more important that you are organized, reliable and punctual, and that you take responsibility for your work. We are looking for someone who sees what needs to be done and enjoys creating structure around them.

You must be able to speak and write English fluently.

PRACTICAL INFORMATION

Position: Kitchen Manager

Hours: Full-time, 37 hours per week

Location: Flyverbyen, Amager

Salary: Based on qualifications

Application deadline: Monday, October 19, 2026

HOW TO APPLY

Please send your application to christian@roeghus.dk no later than October 19, 2026.

If you have any questions about the position, please contact us at the same email address.

We look forward to hearing from you — and hopefully welcoming you to RØGHUS.

Perfect match much?

jobs.occupation: Forklift Driver for Picking, 32 hours per week, Aalborg
jobs.description:
Job Description

• 
Job ID: 361057

• 
Date posted: 29.10.2026

Who you are

Do you love to use your physicality in your work? If so, you are a good match as a logistics co-worker for the Full serve department at IKEA. We work in the part of the warehouse that is not open to customers.

To be successful in this job, you:

• Must have a danish license for operating forklifts

• Are in good physical shape and can handle manual labor

• Are motivated by prioritizing and organizing your work to make efficient use of time

• Are good at creating overviews and have attention to detail

• Have good self-discipline and thrive in routine tasks.

A day in your life with us

Your primary task will be picking up customer orders using manual labor, pallet lifter, and driving a forklift. Therefore, it is not unlikely you will pack and handle several tons of goods every day. When orders are being expedited online or in the store, your job is to find and pack the goods for the customers, and secure that the right goods are packed as fast as possible and without any damages and flaws. You primarily work independently, but with colleagues close by.

Your task will be:

• Picking orders from the store as well as click & collect orders

• Maintenance of machinery and cleaning up the department

• Working together and following up with colleagues from other logistics departments as well as customer service and sales.

Together as a team

Here you will become part of an international team of both fulltime and part-time employees that work towards a common goal. We secure efficient logistics in the store and provide good customer service, even though we do not have direct customer contact. We work closely together with all departments, and consequently you gain experience in collaborating with many different types of people. We work in a fast-paced environment, but always support each other and work as a team. Therefore, there is room for you to be exactly who you are, and you will get the opportunity to gain a strong social network. We will ensure the correct training, so you will feel safe and competent in the job.

Apply now!

If you have any questions please contact Fulfilment Operations Team Leader, Morten George, at morten.george@ingka.ikea.com. Please notice that we do not receive applications via e-mail but only through our recruitment portal.

Other information

• This position is for an average of 32 hours per week.

• Your working hours may vary depending on operational needs, with weekday shifts typically between 7 AM and 4 PM, and you should expect to work every other weekend, including both Saturday and Sunday. It is possible to give your input to the work schedule.

• Salary is within IKEAs banding for logistics and includes pension- and free choice allowance and odd hour payment.

• Other employment terms follow HKs Funktionæroverenskomst.

• We have various staff benefits including private health insurance, massage, kantine, staff discount, discount club with external partners, yearly gift, bonus etc.

• During the recruitment process, we reserve the right to ask for a criminal record.

• Start date as soon as possible

• We have an ongoing interview process and reserve the right to close the job when we have received enough qualified candidates.

Like homes, talent is also diverse, and in IKEA we have a passion for real people. When applying for jobs, some are discouraged if they do not meet every single competence area, but please feel free to still apply. We would love to get to know you as there is a wide range of opportunities in IKEA, based on desire, ability, and experience - whether you are young, senior, or somewhere in between. We hope you will join us on this adventure and we are looking forward to hearing from you!

TIPSTER is looking for a Partnerships & Events Manager to shape, secure, and deliver the drops, pop-ups, and events we bring to hundreds of thousands of community members. Working closely with our leadership and operations team, you’ll build lasting relationships with hospitality partners, negotiate collaborations, and take an active role in bringing them to life.

TIPSTER is on a mission to change how people discover food and drink. Our drops are curated, limited-time offers that connect our community with exceptional food-and-beverage concepts. Alongside collaborations with names such as Gasoline Grill, Ceres, and Atelier September, we create events and pop-ups around the world, including our BAKERY RUN series.

This is a hands-on role for someone with experience in hospitality and sales who is as comfortable closing a sale as they are helping run an event. You’ll have a direct influence on who we work with and what our community gets to experience, with your focus shifting between sales and events throughout the year.

YOU WILL

• Identify and approach restaurants, cafés, bakeries, and other hospitality concepts for drops.

• Develop and pitch drop concepts, negotiate terms, and secure agreements with partners.

• Build and maintain long-term partner relationships, developing opportunities for repeat collaborations.

• Help develop new event and pop-up concepts and research potential venues and partners.

• Coordinate with venues, partners, and suppliers to keep plans, timelines, and practical details on track.

• Take part in the hands-on execution of events and pop-ups, from preparation and setup to on-site operations and follow-up.

All work will take place at our office in Frederiksberg.

WHO YOU ARE

• Experienced in sales, with 2-4 years of relevant professional experience and a background in the restaurant or food-and-beverage industry (e.g., you have a wine sales rep background or similar).

• Outgoing and confident in approaching new partners, with a strong instinct for building lasting relationships.

• Genuinely interested in restaurants, cafés, bakeries, and the people behind them.

• Commercially minded and comfortable pitching ideas, negotiating terms, and closing deals.

• Organized and detail-oriented, with the ability to manage several collaborations at different stages.

• Proactive and dependable, taking ownership of tasks and following them through to completion.

• Comfortable balancing relationship building and sales with practical, hands-on event work.

• Adaptable when priorities shift and eager to develop your skills in partnerships and events.

WHAT TIPSTER OFFERS

• A direct role in shaping how our community discovers great places around the world through drops, events, and pop-ups.

• A place on a team challenging how people discover and experience food and drink.

• Responsibility and opportunities to grow from day one.

• The opportunity to build long-term relationships with some of the world’s best restaurants, cafés, bakeries, and food-and-beverage concepts.

• A varied working day that combines commercial responsibility, creative development, and hands-on execution.

• An informal, collaborative workplace with a small, globally active team.

HOW TO APPLY

If you have any questions about the position, please contact Emma Trøst, Head of Operations, at emma@tipster.io or Julie Schacht, Event & Operations Manager, at julie@tipster.io.

If TIPSTER’s mission aligns with your ambitions, send your cover letter, CV, and any relevant supporting documents to career@tipster.io.

We are looking to fill the position as soon as possible, but we are willing to wait for the right candidate.

Are you up for a challenge?

We are looking for a senior project manager with commercial understanding and technical flair. Ideally with experience from international projects touching upon both civil works and production systems (Mech/Elec/Aut) as we participate in both greenfield and brownfield projects around the world.

The Company

Frontmatec is recognized for developing and delivering high-quality systems across the entire meat industry value chain - ranging from carcass classification, slaughtering lines, and cutting and deboning lines, to hygiene solutions, control systems, logistics, and packaging. Frontmatec's value propositions center on providing equipment that enhances competitiveness by increasing yield, improving raw material utilization, raising hygiene standards, and reducing dependence on labor resources. As a result, the company's customers typically are high-volume slaughterhouses, where optimization leads to significant efficiency gains.

In 2022, Frontmatec Group was acquired by Kohlberg Kravis Roberts & Co. (in the following referred to as KKR), a leading American investment firm with a portfolio of over 700 companies worldwide. Following the acquisition, KKR established Fortifi, a dedicated FoodTech division focused on acquiring and developing companies within the industry. Fortifi brings together innovative businesses to drive technological advancements and operational excellence across the food sector. Within Fortifi, Frontmatec is the largest player, contributing significantly to the group's expertise and market presence. There is a total of 3,000+ employees across Fortifi. Frontmatec serves as the key driver of innovation and growth within this expanding portfolio.

Your Future Role

The role of a Senior Project Manager is to lead complex and business-critical customer projects, ensure successful delivery, and contribute to the continuous development of project execution, customer relationships, and organizational capabilities.

Primary Responsibilities

· Lead and manage complex or high-impact customer projects end-to-end

· Ensure delivery on time, within budget, and in line with quality standards

· Act as primary point of contact and build strong customer relationships

· Lead cross-functional project teams and ensure high performance

· Drive planning, scheduling, and financial tracking with transparency

· Proactively manage risks, opportunities, and margin development

· Coordinate execution phases including implementation and delivery

· Act as escalation point for stakeholders

· Ensure alignment between commercial, technical, and operational aspects

· Drive lessons learned and continuous improvement

Accountabilities

· Overall responsibility for project performance and customer satisfaction

· Leadership of cross-functional teams and delivery excellence

· Financial performance including budget control and forecasting

· Application of project governance and best practices

· Team performance and collaboration

· Improvement of execution efficiency

About you

To be successful in this role you need to have:

- Good stakeholder management skills

- Financial and technical understanding

- Fluency in minimum Danish and English languages

- Ability to travel internationally (30-45 days / year)

- Experience with larger projects +10 mil USD

- Persistence and an eye to critical details

Ideally you also have:

- One or more project management certifications

- Experience from the food industry/ meat industry

- Experience working in AX 2012

What is in it for you

We welcome you to a messy environment where we are currently streamlining and cleaning up. The salary is only decent given the occasional hectic environment and ad hoc challenges that can occur in our projects. However, the team is great and the company is full of good and helpful colleagues. Furthermore, you will have a stake in our company as you will become an owner cf. Fortify's Ownership Programme.

Company Description

Are you curious about modern software development and looking for your next challenge? At Deloitte Engineering, we are seeking motivated part-time student helpers who want to take an active role in improving their technical and problem-solving competencies while growing our Engineering practice.

With more than 2.700 employees Deloitte is the largest audit and consultancy firm in Denmark. We tailor solutions across Audit, Tax, Financial Advisory Services, Enterprise Risk Services, and Consulting.

About the team

We, the Engineering offering of Deloitte Technology & Transformation Denmark, are on the lookout for additional team-players for our quickly growing practice of software engineers, cloud consultants, and IT management consultants. We assist our clients, some of the largest companies, agencies, and organizations in Denmark and the Nordics, on the implementation of new cloud-native systems as part of their digital transformation – and we need you to help build their opportunities and meet their challenges!

Together, we will accelerate your career towards becoming a proficient software engineer and enable a smooth transition to a potential full-time position after your studies. At Deloitte, we are committed to empowering you throughout your career development. As a new employee, you are assigned a talent manager to support your career aspirations and development. You will also be part of a tech community with monthly meetings in which we share knowledge, investigate new topics, and upskill within relevant technologies and methodologies.

Job Description

As a student worker at the Engineering offering, you will be supporting experienced developers on many different projects. To thrive in our team, you embrace working with varying tech-stacks and different aspects of development. Our client assignments can vary greatly, but common for all of them are that we strive to work with the technologies that the client prefers. Regardless of the technology, we provide you with the opportunity and tools needed to learn and grow within all of them.

In this role, you will make an impact by:

• Developing applications and solutions of all sizes, frequently in Agile settings (SAFE/Scrum). This includes both backend and frontend development, often directed towards public clouds or on-premises.

• Enabling DevOps through development of CI/CD pipelines and infrastructure-as-code.

• Building internal capabilities through community tasks, maybe within new business areas.

• Joining in on workshops and sales pitches and contributing to proposals for new client projects.

Qualifications

You are a Master's student at the top of your class, preferably within Computer Science, Engineering, or similar with at least one year of studies left and the energy to work 15-20 hours per week with us. Furthermore, you are either a native Danish speaker or highly proficient in written and spoken Danish.

What you bring to the team:

• Programming-wise, you have experience with either Java, C#/.Net, Python, C, C++, GO, Clojure or JavaScript/TypeScript.

• You have strong analytical skills and a focus on quality and detail.

• You are a positive-minded teammate with the ability to work and solve problems in a structured way.

• You can communicate and express yourself clearly and concisely, both orally and in writing.

Even if you do not see yourself in all the bullets above, we still encourage you to apply if you believe your skills can make an impact on our team.

What we can offer you

We highly appreciate the knowledge, experience, and perspectives our consultants bring, and in exchange, we make sure they develop professionally, meet their career goals, and enjoy their time with Deloitte. Therefore, other than an incredible social calendar, we offer our consultants:

• Enrolment in the Consultant Academy, which is our training program for building the essential Consultant skills. The Academy takes you to exciting locations to learn from leading professionals in their respective fields.

• Focused career development by assigning you a talent manager who acts as your mentor and guides you in your professional journey in Deloitte.

• The opportunity to participate in projects and internal work with our different market offerings to find the right fit for you.

On the social aspect, Deloitte Technology & Transformation is second to none. We offer everything from various sports communities to festivals – not to mention the yearly Trip where all our colleagues come together off-site to create lasting memories. Additionally, we have a strong sense of belonging and community in Engineering, and we support each other every day to make an impact with our clients and to promote personal and professional development.

Additional Information

Do you want to be part of our team?

Send your application, CV, and other relevant documents before the 1st of November, 2026. We process applications and arrange interviews continually, so we recommend that you apply as soon as possible.

Expected start date: Before or 1st of January, 2027

Please do not hesitate to contact Sophus Benee Olsen at soolsen@deloitte.dk if you have any questions about the position.

This role is part of a pilot where we are testing an innovative approach to recruitment using AI, and therefore you should not upload a traditional cover letter. At Deloitte, we value different skills, perspectives, and experiences, as it enables us to effectively solve complex challenges for our clients. We encourage you to apply for the position if you believe your skills can contribute to our team´s success.
